en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a stone-paved square in an old European city. On the right stands a large Baroque church with statues on the façade and dome, fronted by steps and a lamppost; to the left is a colonnaded arcade framing the scene with several people in dark coats and hats walking or standing. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Dubrovnik" and the photographer credit "Foto Berner".
